Author: Anmi (EN fork by lexxxgo)
Name: Beastmaster Assistant (EN)
Punchline: Tracks Beastmaster progression and Beast Catalog collection progress.
Description: Beastmaster Assistant tracks the Beastmaster quest chain and Beast Catalog collection progress, with automatic capture-message logging and navigation to quests and catalog targets. Can work with vnavmesh and Lifestream for same-map movement and cross-map teleporting. Command: /beastmaster output toggles Auto Rotation on/paused. This is an English translation fork of the original plugin by Anmi.
